recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下淋巴結結構完全被瀰漫浸潤取代、看不到濾泡與邊緣竇，間質中可見許多分枝狀小血管，浸潤並越過被膜延伸到周圍脂肪組織；這種「結構抹除＋血管增生＋結外延伸」的組合提示 AITL。
features: Complete effacement of nodal architecture; no residual follicles or open subcapsular sinus identified
Diffuse polymorphous-appearing infiltrate with a mottled pale/dark pattern at low power
Prominent arborizing small vessels scattered throughout the node (hypervascularity)
Infiltrate extends through the capsule into perinodal adipose tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows complete effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate with a mottled appearance. Numerous branching small vessels are present throughout, imparting a hypervascular appearance. The peripheral (subcapsular) sinus is not identifiable, and the infiltrate extends beyond the capsule into the perinodal adipose tissue. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification; in conjunction with TFH-marker immunohistochemistry and expanded FDC meshworks, the findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes retain follicles and patent sinuses and do not show capsular breach with perinodal fat infiltration.
Can efface the node similarly, but lacks the characteristic arborizing HEV proliferation, extrafollicular FDC expansion and TFH phenotype.
Separated at higher power by Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak phenotype in a mixed inflammatory background.
Shows scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background without FDC meshwork expansion or TFH-marker-positive neoplastic T cells.
